name: Jai Mahal at Castle Mandawa
signature_dish: candlelit Rajasthani dinner with folk performance
why_it_matters: Multi-cuisine restaurant inside the Castle Mandawa heritage hotel — the most-visited stay in the Shekhawati haveli circuit. Mural-decorated dining hall plus a candlelit lawn dinner with fire-dancers and folk drums.
insider_tip: The lawn dinner with the fire dancer is a fixed-evening event — confirm at booking, not on arrival. Order the ker sangri specifically; it's the regional dish least often done well outside heritage kitchens.
signature_address: Castle Mandawa, Mandawa, Jhunjhunu District, Rajasthan 333704

name: Hotel Mandawa Haveli Rooftop
why_it_matters: Heritage haveli built in 1890 by a Marwari jeweller, converted to a hotel near Sonthaliya Gate in Mandawa — the air-conditioned ground floor handles breakfast and lunch buffets, while dinner moves to the rooftop with candle-lit table service.
insider_tip: Dinner only on the rooftop — confirm whether the property has switched venues that evening (they do during winter wind events). Reasonable wine list compared to other Shekhawati haveli stays.
signature_address: Hotel Mandawa Haveli, near Sonthaliya Gate, Mandawa, Jhunjhunu District, Rajasthan 333704

name: Badshah Pasand at Roop Niwas Kothi
why_it_matters: Heritage hotel running since 1928, built by Rawal Madan Singh — Rajasthani-Indian restaurant called Badshah Pasand, supplied by an on-site organic farm and dairy with milk from indigenous Indian cows. Marwari, Kathiawadi and Sindhi horses still housed in the stables on the same property.
insider_tip: Time dinner around dusk — the lawn fills with peacocks at that hour and the buffet starts at sundown. The owners run horse-safari programmes; non-residents can book a riding-and-dinner combo.
signature_address: Roop Niwas Kothi, Nawalgarh, Jhunjhunu District, Rajasthan 333042

name: Narayan Niwas Castle Restaurant
why_it_matters: Castle commissioned in 1768 by Thakur Nahar Singh, still owned and run by the same Mahansar family — the property hasn't been re-built during conversion, so the restaurant sits in the original castle hall. Ranked #1 of 1 hotel in Mahansar on TripAdvisor (it's the only one).
insider_tip: Mahansar is small and dark at night — confirm the dinner-time slot when booking; the kitchen runs on a household schedule, not a hotel one.
signature_address: Narayan Niwas Castle, Mahansar, Jhunjhunu District, Rajasthan 333028
